title: DocsIndex
description: What `docs()` returns with no argument (RFC §5.2.1): the list of topics the corpus can answer, so an agent can orient in one call. Topic NAMES only, never the topics themselves. The index is a menu, not the meal, and that is normative: context economy is the product, and an index that carries summaries has already un-solved the problem the contract exists to solve.

topics.description: Topic names the corpus can answer. MAY be empty.
